title: Edit a Slack message with AI using the exact message
h1: correct the slack message people already have
description: Ask a bot to update one Slack message after finding the exact message. Review replacement wording and keep thread broadcasts under your instructions.
answer: a bot can replace the visible content of an existing slack message when you point it at the message; it finds the exact one before editing. editing is a write rather than a send in dusk. if you want to review the correction first, say so in the request before granting access to this action.
what:
use an edit when the message people already saved has the wrong address or a changed deadline. point the bot at the message and have it read the original before preparing a correction.

for ordinary wording, the action takes markdown text. structured slack blocks are an alternative for a layout that needs them; it can only attach files that are already in slack.
uses: correct the check-in address in an event announcement people have already bookmarked
update a status message with a new confirmed delivery time
replace outdated instructions in a thread reply without broadcasting it to the whole channel

routine.message: every friday at 08:50, find the specific slack announcement i linked for the brackley depot collection. compare its collection time with the confirmed time i gave you in this chat, and show me a replacement here only if they differ. ask before updating that exact message, using ordinary markdown and no thread broadcast. never post a second announcement or touch another message.
routine.needs: slack connected with read and write access to locate and update the specified message
routine.output:
brackley depot announcement
original: collection at 15:00, east entrance.
proposed correction: collection at 16:00, east entrance.
original message located; awaiting your permission to replace its wording.

steps: allow the message editor in **Connected apps** with **read and write** slack access and a restricted action list.
give it the message reference and ask it to confirm the channel and original text before any revision.
request a proposed replacement in chat, with an explicit wait for your agreement. **Ask every time** under sending does not supervise this edit.
inspect the changed message after the first correction. **Pause** the routine if the announcement no longer needs maintenance.
watch: a channel name alone doesn't say which announcement to replace. point the bot at the message and check its original text.
broadcasting an edited thread reply is an optional input. leave it off when a correction should stay inside the thread.

faq.q: will editing show a sending approval card?
faq.a: this action is classified as a write. add an explicit ask-before-updating instruction if you need a checkpoint before the message changes.

faq.q: can it attach a new local file during the edit?
faq.a: it can only attach files that are already uploaded to slack. uploading a new file is separate from this message update.
